title: Me and the Prez, Drinking Under the Stars
titleEnglish: Me and the Prez, Drinking Under the Stars
titleRomaji: Shachou to Sake to Hoshi
titleNative: 社長と酒と星
synopsis: At 24, Reina Izutsu has recently become the new president of Izutsu Printing after taking over for her late father. Young and not quite experienced, Reina wants to do her best but unfortunately comes across as harsh with her employees. Stressed and feeling lost, Reina spends an evening drowning her sorrows in beer at an empty park. She rants and vents out loud to the starry sky that she wants to give up and quit being president, just letting off steam. Except, she fails to realize that her subordinate, 37-year-old section chief Kenichi Ishizumi, heard her drunken ramblings! But rather than use this against her, Kenichi finds himself charmed by the young woman. He vows then and there to support her and help her find her way as company president, no matter what! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Though there aren't any major changes, she embarks with the Yeti to explore the small “sparks of joy” in her daily life!

But Sachko's first impression of her was that “she's so cool...” After graduation, Yukie and Sachiko started living together in Tokyo. However, Yukie, an office lady, and Sachiko, the manager of a lesbian bar, have opposite life schedules, so they even though they live in the same house, it's like they live apart from each other. The only time they have together is on Sundays! They were enjoying their day off going out shopping, when they meet a woman who seems familiar...? Note: Published at COMITIA149.

synopsis: Kitami, a boy serving as class representative, is struggling to get a girl named Toujou — who transferred into the class in the middle of the semester — to fit in better with the class. But try as he might, his effort just goes nowhere. That's the situation when one day, a theft incident occurs in class. Toujou is suspected of being the culprit and becomes the target of bullying. Kitami desperately tries to stand up for her, but he gradually becomes isolated... (Source: Gangan Online, translated)
chapterSourceTitle: Let’s Start The Closing Meeting. ~ So Begins The Bullying Trial ~

synopsis: Himari Inuzuka, a cheerful girl who's never been in love, and Yuu Natsume, a flower-loving boy, became friends by chance. Two years later, the two are still best friends. But when Yuu is reunited with his former crush, the relationship between Himari and Yuu began to change......? (Source: Dengeki Daioh, translated)
